{{Quote|Enemies are not accidental or unfortunate. We make them, we earn them, and we nurture them, whether we realize it or not. If we can't find real enemies, we'll invent them and make them as big as we can. They become our justification for existing, or excuses for our own failings. Many of us would suffer if we didn't have them - who would need Jedi if there were no dark Force users?|Lord [[Gajakur Biul]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Kilian Rangers''' were a group of [[Force Adept]]s found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. They were descendants of [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] who had settled on Kilia IV before [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The Rangers and their people had lost all contact with [[The galaxy/Legends|the outside galaxy]], but this was soon to end under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The Rangers were integrated into the aristocratic hierarchy of Kilia IV as servants of the local [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], though they swore also to protect the common people. They valued chivalry, justice, and the rule of law. When they became aware of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children, they would apprentice them as Squires around puberty. Squires served Kilian Rangers as apprentices and servants. The most powerful Kilian Rangers, equivalent to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], were called Kilian Lords.

At any one time there were no more than five members, usually one Kilian Lord, two Rangers and two Squires.

Unfortunately, at some point the Kilian Rangers experienced a schism, much like the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] aligned [[Renegades]] were born.

Kilian Rangers used ancient technology called [[Shield gauntlet/Legends|shield gauntlets]] and [[Siang lance/Legends|siang lances]] as part of their symbolism and training. The shield gauntlet was a small [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]] worn on the off-hand which could be used to absorb and even deflect energy weapons and shots, though its range was no more than a few feet. The siang lance was a weapon built from an ancient [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]], fitted with a [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]]. Rangers often imbued their lances with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The majority of their Force-based skillset involved deflection, using their shield gauntlet. They could redirect blaster bolts at other targets, and successfully deflect fully automatic fire.
